stories.title: Verify CONTRACT.md documents every implemented route (single source, versioned)
stories.scope: platform/CONTRACT.md:3 (version line + 'Additive changes only; if you change a shape, bump this file first'), :9-161 (route headings); platform/src/index.ts:1108-1155 (route literals). The check is the executable form of 'single source of route shapes; no producer or consumer ships an undocumented shape': set equality between implemented routes and documented route headings.
stories.acceptance: CONTRACT.md carries a `Version: vN` line and the additive-only law; the set of route literals implemented in platform/src/index.ts (`url.pathname === "<route>"`) equals the set of route headings documented in platform/CONTRACT.md (`/health`, `/changes`, `/proposals`, `/merge`, `/land`, `/judge`, `/events`) — a route added in code without a same-slice CONTRACT.md entry (or a documented route the worker does not implement) fails the check. Exit 0 prints both sets.

stories.title: Verify wrong-method requests are answered by the API routes with a JSON error
stories.scope: platform/src/index.ts:1104-1155 — the router clauses gate on `url.pathname` (+ method only where present). The consequence 'every API route enforces its method' lives here, before the terminal asset fallthrough at :1154-1155.
stories.acceptance: For each documented route, the non-documented method (POST /health, POST /changes, POST /proposals, POST /merge, GET /land, GET /judge, POST /events) is answered by the worker — not the asset handler — with 4xx and `content-type: application/json` carrying `{ok:false,error}`; no probe may return 2xx or an empty/non-JSON asset response. The check lists every failing probe and exits non-zero.

If confirmed at verification time, reclassify FR-42 build-gap for the method-guard half (repair: worker-level 405 JSON for documented paths with an undocumented method, placed before the asset fallthrough).
